name: Henry Glen
bio: A Representative from New York; born in Schenectady, N.Y., July 13, 1739; appointed clerk of Schenectady County, N.Y., February 27, 1767-March 11, 1809; served in the Revolutionary War, deputy quartermaster general; member of the First, Second, and Third New York Provincial Congresses, 1774-1776; served as a member of the New York assembly, 1786 and 1787; elected as a Pro-Administration candidate to the Third Congress and reelected as a Federalist to the three succeeding Congresses (March 4, 1793-March 3, 1801); member of the New York state assembly, 1810; died on January 6, 1814, in Schenectady, N.Y.
